verses.1: God blessed Noah and his sons and said to them, "Be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth.
verses.2: Every animal, bird, crawling creature, and fish will fear you. They are given into your hands.
verses.3: Every living creature will be food for you. Just as I gave you the green plants, I now give you everything.
verses.4: But you must not eat meat that still has its lifeblood in it.
verses.5: I will also require an accounting for human life. From every animal and from every person I will require it. From one person to another I will require an accounting for human life.
verses.6: Whoever sheds the blood of a person, by a person shall that person's blood be shed, for God made mankind in His own image.
verses.7: As for you, be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth."
verses.8: Then God said to Noah and to his sons,
verses.9: "I am now establishing My covenant with you and with your children after you,
verses.10: and with every living creature that came out of the ark with you — the birds, the livestock, and every animal on earth.
verses.11: I establish My covenant with you: never again will all life be cut off by the waters of a flood, and never again will a flood destroy the earth."
verses.12: God said, "This is the sign of the covenant I am making between Me and you and every living creature with you, for all generations to come:
verses.13: I have placed My rainbow in the clouds, and it will be the sign of the covenant between Me and the earth.
verses.14: Whenever I bring clouds over the earth and the rainbow appears in the clouds,
verses.15: I will remember My covenant between Me and you and every living creature. The waters will never again become a flood to destroy all life.
verses.16: Whenever the rainbow appears in the clouds, I will see it and remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature on the earth."
verses.17: God said to Noah, "This is the sign of the covenant I have established between Me and all life on the earth."
verses.18: The sons of Noah who came out of the ark were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham was the father of Canaan.
verses.19: These three were the sons of Noah, and from them all the people of the earth descended.
verses.20: Noah became a farmer and planted a vineyard.
verses.21: He drank some of the wine, became drunk, and lay uncovered inside his tent.
verses.22: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw his father uncovered and went outside and told his two brothers.
verses.23: Shem and Japheth took a garment and laid it across both their shoulders. They walked in backward and covered their father without looking at him.
verses.24: When Noah woke up from his wine and learned what his youngest son had done to him,
verses.25: he said, "Cursed be Canaan. He will be a servant of servants to his brothers."
verses.26: He also said, "Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem. May Canaan be the servant of Shem.
verses.27: May God enlarge the territory of Japheth, and may he dwell in the tents of Shem. May Canaan be his servant."
verses.28: After the flood Noah lived 350 more years.
verses.29: Thus all the days of Noah were 950 years, and he died.

metadata.source: Based on the Authorized King James Version (1769), reinterpreted through the theology of abiding in Christ.
